# Glossary

## Example term

<a id="example-term"></a>

Aliases: sample term.

A term defined once and linked from the concepts that use it. The anchor above equals the automatic slug of the term when it was created and never changes.

Source: [Open Knowledge Format specification](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format).
